## My request:
我想搭建一款造景贴纸小游戏 目前我搜集了一些其他市面上的游戏 可以模拟他们的游戏来搭建 不过目前市面上大多数游戏都是以可爱画风的游戏 而我想做的是像实体贴纸一样不同的风格 以及大图 用分开在最后合并的方式将大图分成几个小部分 最后合并成一张大图 也不会丢失游戏的趣味性 具体风格的素材我也会上传给你 你先通过[@GitHub](plugin://github@openai-curated-remote) 看看有没有需要的插件自己安装上 再告诉我应该如何用codex来搭建 其他游戏的游玩形式和内容以及我想做的游戏画风素材我都会上传给你

items.text:
我确认了问题来源：素材包里的 500 张贴纸是另画的素材，并不是这张完整画的对应分层，所以继续调整它们的位置也无法准确还原原画。

这版会改用原画本身切取内容，保留原来的位置、比例和遮挡；屋顶与房屋成组保留。区域里的内容全部补齐后才过关，最后会把拼好的大图与原图逐像素核对。

box(6,'west-upper-balcony','茶舍上层阳台与盆栽',(58,388,217,516))
box(6,'west-lower-display','茶舍窗边陈设',(88,535,219,654))

add(6,'west-teahouse-building','河岸茶舍与完整屋顶',[(0,286),(107,283),(181,326),(216,400),(220,537),(278,565),(283,705),(253,747),(194,770),(60,791),(0,807)],'building')
add(6,'west-back-shop','灰顶小铺与完整屋顶',[(24,271),(124,249),(213,295),(284,307),(304,337),(328,418),(305,468),(245,475),(217,412),(158,335)],'building')
box(6,'west-willow','河岸柳树与绿荫',(0,308,78,844),'greenery')

# 8. Bridge and boats, held in native pixels throughout.
box(7,'bridge-upper-walker','桥上行人',(563,570,620,663))
box(7,'bridge-flowers','桥头花盆',(355,607,426,715))
add(7,'bridge-complete-stone','完整石桥与桥栏',[(376,626),(478,630),(564,653),(625,665),(689,662),(724,703),(738,760),(685,779),(625,766),(552,724),(510,719),(466,770),(395,778),(351,746),(326,693)],'structure')

box(8,'garden-bench-people','树下长椅与人物',(1003,581,1140,683))
box(8,'garden-pump','水泵与洗手池',(966,751,1047,823))
box(8,'garden-front-woman','桥头女士',(707,725,776,844),claim=True)
box(8,'garden-front-person','花园里的行人',(767,794,838,898))
box(8,'garden-street-person','树旁行人',(1064,646,1113,756))
box(8,'garden-bicycle','花园自行车与盆花',(615,761,692,838))
box(8,'garden-lamp','花园街灯',(873,809,919,933))
box(8,'garden-fence-flowers','临河花栏与花草',(643,846,1081,940),'structure')
add(8,'garden-whole-tree','完整大树与树干',[(723,557),(794,540),(886,544),(973,542),(998,593),(1070,595),(1078,672),(1001,715),(963,748),(934,835),(910,841),(886,763),(797,735),(739,723),(682,662),(720,618)],'greenery')

# Transfer a small visible object that crosses a geographic edge as a whole.
# This changes ownership only; its source pixels and position never change.
for group in groups:
    if group['claim']:
        owner[shape(group['polygon'])]=group['region']

allocated=np.zeros((H,W),dtype=bool)
cutouts=[]
for group in groups:
    mask=shape(group['polygon'])&(owner==group['region'])&~allocated
    if np.count_nonzero(mask)<80:
        continue
    allocated|=mask
    cutouts.append((group,mask))

# Everything else in a region is still gameplay content: pave all the streets,
# water, distant details and remaining plants, not just a selected object list.
yy,xx=np.indices((H,W))
for rid,region in enumerate(draft['regions']):
    rest=(owner==rid)&~allocated
    ys,xs=np.where(rest)
    assert len(xs)
    x0,x1=xs.min(),xs.max();y0,y1=ys.min(),ys.max()
    # Irregular masks inherit the actual region and foreground outlines.
    seeds=[(x0+(x1-x0)*.27,y0+(y1-y0)*.28),
           (x0+(x1-x0)*.74,y0+(y1-y0)*.48),
           (x0+(x1-x0)*.40,y0+(y1-y0)*.83)]
    distances=np.stack([((xx-x)/max(1,x1-x0))**2+((yy-y)/max(1,y1-y0))**2 for x,y in seeds])
    nearest=np.argmin(distances,axis=0)
    for n in range(3):
        mask=rest&(nearest==n)
        if not np.any(mask):continue
        group=dict(region=rid,id=f"{region['key']}-backdrop-{n+1}",name=f"{region['name']}·街景底纸{n+1}",kind='backdrop')
        cutouts.append((group,mask));allocated|=mask

assert allocated.all()
count=np.zeros((H,W),dtype=np.uint8)
rebuilt=np.zeros((H,W,3),dtype=np.uint8)
items=[];catalog=[];regions=[];regionids={i:[] for i in range(len(draft['regions']))}
kind_order={'backdrop':0,'building':1,'structure':2,'greenery':3,'detail':4}
cutouts.sort(key=lambda pair:(pair[0]['region'],kind_order[pair[0]['kind']]))
for group,mask in cutouts:
    ys,xs=np.where(mask);x0,x1=int(xs.min()),int(xs.max())+1;y0,y1=int(ys.min()),int(ys.max())+1
    cut=rgb[y0:y1,x0:x1]
    rgba=np.zeros((y1-y0,x1-x0,4),dtype=np.uint8)
    local=mask[y0:y1,x0:x1]
    rgba[local,:3]=cut[local]
    rgba[local,3]=255
    id=group['id'];file=f'stickers/{id}.png';Image.fromarray(rgba).save(OUT/file,optimize=True)
    count[mask]+=1;rebuilt[mask]=rgb[mask]
    regionids[group['region']].append(id)
    catalog.append(dict(id=id,name=group['name'],file=file,native_size_px=[x1-x0,y1-y0],
        source_bbox_px=[x0,y0,x1,y1],pixel_count=int(local.sum()),
        region=draft['regions'][group['region']]['key'],kind=group['kind'],
        png_sha256=hashlib.sha256((OUT/file).read_bytes()).hexdigest()))
    items.append(dict(id=id,assetId=id,name=group['name'],image='./assets/exact/'+file,
        crop=[0,0,x1-x0,y1-y0],target=dict(x=x0,y=y0,w=x1-x0,h=y1-y0),
        z=kind_order[group['kind']],dependencies=[],sourcePixelCount=int(local.sum())))

# Ground first, intact architecture next, then its visible foreground details.
for rid in regionids:
    local=[(g,m) for g,m in cutouts if g['region']==rid]
    backgrounds=[g['id'] for g,m in local if g['kind']=='backdrop']
    buildings=[g['id'] for g,m in local if g['kind']=='building']
    for item in items:
        if item['id'] not in regionids[rid]:continue
        kind=next(g['kind'] for g,m in local if g['id']==item['id'])
        if kind!='backdrop':item['dependencies']=backgrounds
        if kind=='detail' and buildings:item['dependencies']+=buildings
    mask=owner==rid;ys,xs=np.where(mask)
    b=dict(x=int(xs.min()),y=int(ys.min()),w=int(xs.max()-xs.min()+1),h=int(ys.max()-ys.min()+1))
    regions.append(dict(key=draft['regions'][rid]['key'],name=draft['regions'][rid]['name'],
        bounds=b,ids=regionids[rid],sourcePixelCount=int(mask.sum())))

assert np.all(count==1),'The original image must have exactly one cutout per pixel.'
assert np.array_equal(rebuilt,rgb),'Full reconstruction must match the user image exactly.'
for rid in regionids:
    assert sum(i['sourcePixelCount'] for i in items if i['id'] in regionids[rid])==int((owner==rid).sum())

Image.new('RGB',(1,1),'#f4f0e7').save(OUT/'paper.png')
shutil.copy2(SOURCE,OUT/'original.png')
Image.fromarray(owner.astype('uint8')).save(OUT/'region-owner.png')
original.save(ROOT/'outputs/旧街市集-原画完成预览.png')
level=dict(id='old-town-original-coverage-02',title='旧街市集',width=W,height=H,
    background='./assets/exact/paper.png',original='./assets/exact/original.png',
    exactComposition=True,assetRoot='./assets/exact/',sourceLibraryCount=len(items),
    retainedIndependentLibraryCount=500)
source='// Exact original-art cutouts. Targets are native coordinates, never re-arranged.\n'
for name,data in [('LEVEL',level),('ITEMS',items),('REGIONS',regions)]:
    source+=f'export const {name} = '+json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+';\n'
source+='export const BY_ID = Object.fromEntries(ITEMS.map(item=>[item.id,item]));\n'
(GAME/'level.js').write_text(source)
catalogdata=dict(title='旧街市集原画可见画面切片',count=len(catalog),source='original.png',
    source_size_px=[W,H],source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(SOURCE.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    trueHiddenLayers=False,assets=catalog)
(OUT/'catalog.json').write_text(json.dumps(catalogdata,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
report=dict(regions=len(regions),stickers=len(items),sourcePixels=W*H,uniqueCoveredPixels=int((count==1).sum()),
    uncoveredPixels=int((count==0).sum()),overlapPixels=int((count>1).sum()),
    completedImageDifferentPixels=int(np.any(rebuilt!=rgb,axis=2).sum()),
    regionCounts=[dict(name=r['name'],pieces=len(r['ids']),pixels=r['sourcePixelCount']) for r in regions])
(OUT/'coverage-proof.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
(WORK/'exact-scene-build-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False))
